description: The pass is set to not recorded over rows that all stand at Supports or Not Applicable. The status sentence is the decision's — machine-audited, and not conformant until the pass is on record. The pass is read before the rows: a rule that read the rows alone would put the stronger word on a report with no transcript behind it, which is the lie 0061 was written against. The rows are the live ones, as in every case that counts them — but where those turn red the day a live row drops below Supports, this one would go on passing as a duplicate of `a-pass-not-on-record-and-a-row-below-supports.json`, so `nothing-holds-the-report-below-supports.json` is its canary and the two are patched together.

says: until the assistive-technology pass is on record
